items.html: And the Nukva of ZA of Beriah has a complete Partzuf and two Makifim: the first is in the secret of the knot of the Tefillin of the head, and this is her upper Makif. And her second, lower Makif is the Tefillin of the arm, for it is Ohr Makif, as is known, for all Tefillin are aspects of Makifim.
